missions.name: The Lost Brother
texts: At the Kha'zeel Mountains you met the merchant Tarun. His brother has gone missing and was last seen following a beautiful woman into a palace. Tarun fears this woman might have been a demon.
You found the remains of Tarun's brother containing a message. Go back to Tarun and report his brother's last words.
You told Tarun about his brother's sad fate. He was very downhearted but gave you his sincere thanks. The beautiful asuri have taken a young man's life and the happiness of another one.

missions.name: Looking for Gnomerik
texts:
The dwarf Xelvar has sent you to meet the gnome Gnomerik. \z
				He can recruit you to the Bigfoot Company. \z
				Use the teleporter near Xelvar to enter the gnomish base and start looking for Gnomerik.

missions.name: A New Recruit
texts: You have found the gnomish recruiter and are ready to become a Bigfoot.

missions.name: Recruitment: A Test in Gnomology
texts:
Pass Gnomerik's test by answering his questions. \z
					If you fail to get a high enough score drink a mushroom beer and start again.

You have passed the gnomish psychology test and can proceed to the medical exam. \z
					Talk to Gnomespector about your next examination.

missions.name: Recruitment: Medical Examination
texts: Walk through the g-ray apparatus for your g-raying.

missions.name: Recruitment: Ear Examination
texts:
You have been g-rayed. It has been an ... unexpected experience. Now you are ready for your \z
					ear examination. Walk up to doctor Gnomedix and wait for him to finish your ear examination.

You passed the ear examination. Well, at least most of you did. \z
					Now talk to Gnomaticus about your next test.

missions.name: Recruitment: Gnomish Warfare
texts: You are now ready for your endurance test. Talk to Gnomewart about it.

missions.name: Recruitment: Endurance Test
texts: Enter the lower chamber for your endurance test. Reach the teleporter north of the hall.
You have passed the endurance test. Report back to Gnomewart.
You passed the endurance test and are ready to talk to Gnomelvis about your soul melody.

missions.name: Recruitment: Soul Melody
texts:
Find your personal soul melody by trial and error. \z
					Create the complete soul melody of seven notes and then report to Gnomelvis. Red notes indicate a failure.
You found your very own soul melody. You should talk to Gnomelvis about it!

missions.name: Recruitment
texts: You are now a true member of the Bigfoot company.

missions.name: Daily Minor: Raiders of the Lost Spark
Daily Major: Matchmaker
texts:
You have to enter the crystal caves and find a crystal that is fitting the crystal you got \z
					from the gnomes. Use the crystal on one of the bigger red crystals in the caves to bond them.
You have finished this quest for now.

missions.name: Daily Major Advanced: Spores
texts:
Gather spores in the correct order. \z
				Your spore gathering list will display the next color you have to look for.

missions.name: Daily Major Advanced: Yet Another Grinding
texts: Gather a grindstone from the lava area en report back.

missions.name: Gnomish War Hero (Warzone 1)
texts: Deliver the Deathstrike's snippet to gnomission to enter the first warzone for free.
You may enter the first warzone without using a mission crystal.

missions.name: Gnomish War Hero (Warzone 2)
texts: Deliver the Gnomevil's hat to gnomission to enter the second warzone for free.
You may enter the second warzone without using a mission crystal.

missions.name: Gnomish War Hero (Warzone 3)

You may enter the third warzone without using a mission crystal.

missions.name: Prove Your Worzz!
texts:
Your Mission is to go to a little camp of lizards at north-east of the Dragonblaze Peaks. \z
					You have to find and deliver the Tactical map complete the mission.
You delivered the Tactical map to Zalamon.

missions.name: Mission 1: Corruption
texts: Go to the Temple of Equilibrium (it's marked on your map) and find out what happened there.
The temple has been corrupted and is lost. Zalamon should be informed about this as soon as possible.
You already reported Zalamon about the Temple! Ask him for new mission!

missions.name: Mission 2: Imperial Zzecret Weaponzz
texts:
Go into the small camp Chaochai to the north of the Dragonblaze Peaks \z
					(Zalamon marks the entrance on your map). There are 3 buildings which you have to spy
You spied 1 of 3 buildings of the camp.
You spied 2 of 3 buildings of the camp.
You spied 3 of 3 buildings of the camp. Zalamon should be informed about this as soon as possible.
You already reported Zalamon about the camp! Ask him for new mission!

missions.name: Mission 3: Zee Killing Fieldzz
texts:
Get the poison from Zalamon's storage room. Then go to the teleporter to the Muggy Plains and head \z
					east from there to the rice fields. Go to the very top rice field and use the poison anywhere on the water.

The rice has been poisoned. This will weaken the Emperor's army significantly. \z
					Return and tell Zalamon about your success.
You already reported Zalamon about your success! Ask him for new mission!

missions.name: Mission 4: Zze Way of Zztonezz
texts:
Your mission is to find a way to enter the north of the valley and find a \z
				passage to the great gate itself. Search any temples or settlements you come across for hidden passages.
Report Zalamon about the strange symbols that you found.
Get the greasy oil from Zalamon's storage room and put them on the levers that you found.
Due to being extra greasy, the leavers can now be moved.

You found the right combination for the puzzle in the mountains and triggered some kind of mechanism. \z
					You should head back to Zalamon to report your success.

You already reported Zalamon about your success! You got a Tome of Knowledge as reward! \z
					Ask him for new mission!

missions.name: Mission 5: Phantom Army
texts: Zalamon has sent you on a quest to find out what lies beneath the secret portal in the temple. Find it and explore the other side.
Eternal guardians and lizard chosen has been awaken. Survive them and report it to Zalamon!
You Survived the Waves and reported Zalamon about your success! You got a Serpent Crest as reward!

missions.name: The Strengthtening of the Minotaurs
texts:
Gerimor told you that the naturalist Jamesfrancis is an expert of minotaurs. \z
				Right now he is investigating a cave in minocity. But this time something seems to be completely different.

Jamesfrancis already entered the inner part of the cave weeks ago but had to flee when \z
				the minotaurs became too strong. He gave you the key to investigate this room as well.
You found an entrance to the minotaur boss. You killed it and now you have to return to Jamesfrancis.
Jamesfrancis sent you to talk with Gerimor about the minotaur cult.
You have reported the Druid of Crunor about the minotaur cult.

missions.name: Patron of Arts
texts:
The Druid of Cronor gave you the hint that the Thais exhibition has expanded. \z
				The new section is called MOTA (Museum of Tibian Arts). It's really worth a visit.

Gareth told you how to become a patron of the arts. To fulfil your duty you have to manage some tasks. \z
				First you have to investigate the crime scene of a theft in the museum.

You found a ransom note, wich requests you to pay some money for \z
				the stolen picture to a stonge in Kazordoon. His name is Iwar. Nevertheless I should talk to Gareth first.

You told Gareth about the ransom note. \z
				He asked you to pay the money to Iwar to get the picture back. In his opinion, there is no alternative.

You paid the money to stooge in Kazordoon. \z
				You were told that the picture is delivered to Gareth himself.

You have to go to Angelo and get a magnifier to investigate all small \z
				pictures in the entrance hall of the MOTA. One of them should be a fake.
Angelo allowed you to take a magnifier from a crate next to the cave entrance.
You've fetched the magnifier from Angelo's crate. You're ready for your job in the museum.
Indeed! One of the investigated small pictures is fake. Report to Gareth!
After you told Gareth about the fake painting, he asked you to go to Angelo to get a new picture.

Angelo was not willing to give you a new picture. \z
				However, they havent found any artefact in the sandy cave yet. Report to Gareth about your failure.

Even though you weren't successful in getting a replacement for the fake picture, \z
				Gareth gave you access to the last floor of the museum. This area is for patrons only.
INTERNAL MESSAGE: THIS NEED QUESTLOG INFORMATION

The Denomintator opened the door for you after you answered his questions to the wanted number. \z
				In the end he mentioned the Druid of Conor. Maybe you should pay him a visit.
In the end you told the Druid of Crunor about your experiences in the MoTA.

missions.name: Barkless
texts:
The members of the Barkless follow a rigid path of hardship and sacrifice. \z
				Their cult is located somewhere beneath Ab'dendriel. \z
				Whatever happened to their leader, only a true Barkless can find out.

You survived the sulphur and tar trial. You accepted the stigma of misfortune and vanity. \z
				The hardest part, however, is yet to come. Give your life to the ice... to become true and purified.

You broke enough Barkless markings to now reverse the seal \z
				held up by the cult object in the ritual chamber. \z
				The power you gained feels unnatural and excessive but it seems ther is no other way.

The Leiden you confronted has strayed far from his own original vision of Barkless. \z
				What you encountered was more monster than elf and less virtuous than his devotees would have you believe.

You returned to Gerimor after putting an end to the mischief of Leyden the Penitent. \z
				May the Barkless walk the true path again one day.

missions.name: Misguided
texts: ASD

Below a ruin in the vicinity of the outlaw camp east of Thais a strange figure in ragged clothes \z
				hinted at something weird going on in a cave. He seemed too confused to decide whether to stop you.

You defeated the cult leader of Misguided by uncovering the true master to pull his strings \z
				and freeing this world from its malicious existance. Return to Gerimor to tell him about the victory.
You have spoken to Gerimor about your victory.

missions.name: The Orc Idol
texts: ASD
ASD

You returned to Gerimor after facing the being the orcs worshipped. \z
				Whatever it was, it did not find the orcs by accident. \z
				A far more powerful force seems to have strategically place it here.

missions.name: The Secret of the Sandy Cave
texts: ASD
ASD

In the cave you haven't found one of the missing scientists. \z
				However, you have faced a lots of strange mummies and a green oasis at the end.

After you informed Angelo about your experiences in the cave, \z
				he asked you to go back to analyse the water of the oasis. For that reason you got an analysis tool.
You have analysed the water with the help of the analysis tool from Angelo.

You informed Angelo about the analyzed water. \z
				He gave you a counteragent, wich you have to apply to the oasis.

You applied the counteragent to the oasis, just like Angelo had asked you to. \z
				But the effect was different from what you had expected. \z
				A sandstorm approached and caused create damage to the oasis.
You Killed the boss
You reported your victory to Angelo

You have told Gerimor about your stay in the sandy cave. \z
				He was not really surprised and felt vindicated that the rumors about a cult in the cave might be true.

missions.name: Zathroth Remmants
texts: ASD

You returned to Gerimor after encounter with the remnants of Zathroth. On one hand its is \z
				furtunate that Zathroth indeed wasn't behind all this, but on the other... what is going on there?

missions.name: Dwarves: Home Improvement
texts: You drove off the Lost but more are sure to come. Check back with Klom Stonecutter at a later time.

missions.name: Dwarves: Subterranean Life
texts:
You helped Klom defend the outpost by cutting down a number of vermin from deep down below. \z
				The gnomes don't seem to completely approve of this but everyone appreciates the drop in the enemy's ranks.

missions.name: Gnomes: Gnomal Warming Measurements
texts:
You helped Lardoc Bashsmite fighting back the verminous growth in the northern mineshaft. \z
				Return to him later to see if he has more work for you.

missions.name: Gnomes: Ordnance
texts:
Gnomus sent you to find and rescue the gnome ordnance the outpost is currently waiting for. \z
				Travel to the east of the cave system and find the old gnome trail where reinforcements will arrive.

You helped Lardoc Bashsmite fighting back the verminous growth in the northern mineshaft. \z
				Return to him later to see if he has more work for you.

missions.name: Gnomes: Uncharted Territory
texts:
You helped Gnomus chart the area around the deep base. You found traces of what \z
				could have been an old civilisation but there's not enough left to draw any conclusion.

missions.name: Scouts: Explosive Growth
texts:
You helped Lardoc Bashsmite fighting back the verminous growth in the northern mineshaft. \z
				Return to him later to see if he has more work for you.

missions.name: Scouts: Pesticide
texts:
You reported back to Lardoc Bashsmite to inform him that the gnome's plan to \z
				neutralise diremaw corpses seems to work.

missions.name: In the Adventures Outpost
texts:
You have reached the Outpost, where young heroes are trained in combat and hunting. \z
			When you have reached level 8 at least, you can leave for the Mainland. Talk to Inigo if you have questions.

missions.name: The Lost Amulet
texts: Mr Morris tasked you to find an ancient amulet that was lost somewhere on Dawnport - probably next to a corpse somewhere.
Come back to Mr Morris.
Mr Morris thanks for you the help.

missions.name: The Stolen Log Book
texts: Mr Morris urged you to find a log book that was stolen by trolls.
Mr Morris thanks you for the help.

missions.name: The Rare Herb
texts: Mr Morris needs the rare Dawnfire herb harvested and brought to him. It grows on gray sand only, he said.
Come back to Mr Morris.
Mr Morris thanks you for the help.

missions.name: The Dorm Key
texts: The key to the adventurer's dormitory has disappeared. Maybe you can find it. Ask around to find out who was the last to have seen it.
Use the fishing rod in the nearby lake to fish Old Nasty.
Come back to Woblin with Old Nasty
Come back to Mr Morris with Key 0010
Mr Morris thanks for the help

missions.name: Circle of the Black Sphinx
texts: You defeated the rogue Lady Tenebris.

missions.name: Bane of the Cosmic Force
texts:
You calmed poor, misguided Lloyd. All he wanted was protection from the outside world. \z
				Luckily he seems to have learned his lesson... or has he?

missions.name: The Desecrated Glade
texts:
You defeated the Thorn Knight and shattered the root of evil with all your might. \z
				The honor of being a guardian of the glade indeed comes with pride as well as responsibility.

missions.name: The Unwary Mage
texts:
With help of Ivalisse from the temple of the Astral Shapers in Thais and her father, \z
				you averted the Dragon King's menace deep in the Zao Muggy Plains.

missions.name: Dragon in Distress
texts: You saved the Dragon Mother's egg and she melted the ice wall that blocked your way.

missions.name: Time is a Window
texts:
You defeated the Time Guardian and are free to return to your own time. \z
				For some creatures in this world, it seems neither past nor future are an obstacle.

missions.name: Final Fight
texts: Description Fault.

missions.name: The Order of the Cobra
texts: Scarlett Etzel once stood proud and righteous. The assassins she rallied around her under the Order of the Cobra, however, were of ill repute and had to be vanquished. And so did she, you prevailed.

missions.name: Mission 01: Something Rotten
texts:
Palimuth asked you to help with some sewer malfunctions. \z
					You will need a Crowbar, there are 4 places where you need to go marked with an X on your map.
You cleaned 1 pipe of 4 from the garbage.
You cleaned 2 pipes of 4 from the garbage.
You cleaned 3 pipes of 4 from the garbage.
You cleaned 4 pipes of 4 from the garbage. Go back to Palimuth and report your mission
You cleaned all pipes from the garbage! Go back to Palimuth and ask for mission.

You reported to 1 of 7 guards
You reported to 2 of 7 guards

You reported to 4 of 7 guards
You reported to 5 of 7 guards

missions.name: Mission 03: Death to the Deathbringer
texts: Get the notes in Palimuths room and read them. Talk to Palimuth again when you've read the notes.
Talk to Azerus the Yalahari in the city centre to get your next mission.

Get the notes behind the Yalahari and read them. \z
					Talk to Azerus again and ask him for mission when you've read the notes.
Ask Palimuth for mission.

First you will need to kill the three plague bearers and then get The Alchemists' Formulas. \z
						When this have been done head back to either Palimuth (good side) or Yalahari (Azerus) (bad side).
Ask Azerus the Yalahari for a mission.

missions.name: Mission 04: Good to be Kingpin
texts: Ask Palimuth for mission.

For this mission you are asked to go to the Trade Quarter and negotiate or threaten Mr. West. \z
					Once again you will gain access to the mechanism although if you \z
					choose to help Palimuth you should go through the sewers.
You decided to help Palimuth, report him your mission.
You decided to help Azerus, report him your mission.
Get back to Azerus and report him your mission.
Ask Azerus for a mission.

missions.name: Mission 05: Food or Fight
texts: Ask Palimuth for mission.

On this mission you are asked to find a druid by the name of Tamerin, on the Arena Quarter. \z
					You now have permission to use the gates mechanism.

The first is to bring Tamerin a flask of Animal Cure, \z
					you can buy this from Siflind on Nibelor (northeast of Svargrond).
now you have to kill Morik the Gladiator and bring his helmet to Tamerin as proof.

Report back to Tamerin as he will listen to your request and you can now make your choice: \z
					Cattle for Palimuth (good side), Warbeasts for Yalahari (Azerus) (bad side). \z
					Then report the one you decided your mission.
You decided to help Palimuth, report him your mission.
You decided to help Azerus, report him your mission.
Ask Azerus for a mission.

missions.name: Mission 06: Frightening Fuel
texts: Ask Palimuth for mission.

Yalahari (Azerus) orders you to travel to the Cemetery Quarter and find the Strange Carving. \z
					He gives you a Ghost Charm and tells you to charge it with the tormented souls of the ghosts there \z
					to be used as an energy source. Palimuth wants the Charged Ghost Charm in order to free those souls. \z
					You can new use the Cemetery Quarter mechanism now. Go to the big building in the Cemetery Quarter and \z
					use the Ghost Charm on the Strange Carving at the back of the room.

Good side: Go to Palimuth, ask him about your mission, and hand in the charm. Bad side: \z
					Ask about your mission to Yalahari (Azerus) and give it back.
Get back to Azerus and report him your mission.
Ask Azerus for a mission.

missions.name: Mission 07: A Fishy Mission
texts: Ask Palimuth for mission.

Bad side: Yalahari (Azerus) will send you for a new mission to go to the Sunken Quarter and kill the \z
					Quara Leaders, Inky, Splasher and Sharptooth. Good side: Rather than fighting any Quara leaders Palimuth \z
					will instead send you to find the cause for the Quaras aggressive behavior. Find Maritima and talk to her \z
					about the Quara and she will explain what their problem is.
Get back to Palimuth and report him your mission.
You killed the Quarabosses. Ask Azerus for a mission.
Ask Azerus for a mission.

missions.name: Mission 08: Dangerous Machinations
texts: Ask Palimuth for mission.

Bad side: For this mission the Yalahari requests you go to the Factory Quarter and \z
					find a pattern crystal, which will be used to supply weapons to help take control of the city. Good side: \z
					Palimuth will send you there to use the crystal to supply food for the city.
Get back to Azerus and report him your mission.
Ask Azerus for a mission.

missions.name: Mission 09: Decision
texts:
You now need to decide between supporting Palimuth or the Yalahari's goal. \z
					To choose Palimuth's good side go to him, and simply ask him for a mission mission. \z
					Likewise, to join the Yalahari (Azerus) (bad side) go to him and say the same.
you already decided!

missions.name: Mission 10: The Final Battle
texts:
Palimuth told you that a circle of Yalahari is planning some kind of ritual. They plan to create \z
					a portal for some powerful demons and to unleash them in the city to 'purge' it once and for all.

The entrance to their inner sanctum has been opened for you. \z
					Be prepared for a HARD battle! Better gather some friends to assist you.
Report back to whichever principal you have chosen to help and you will receive Yalaharian Outfits.

You got the access to the reward room. \z
					Choose carefully which reward you pick as you can only take one item.
You have completed the Quest!

missions.name: Mission 1: The Plans
texts:
Spectulus in Edron has sent you on a mission to find out the whereabouts of a certain inventor. \z
					A beggar in Edron seems to know more about this topic than he wants to tell.

The beggar turned out to be the inventor himself. \z
					You successfully convinced him to give you the only remaining plans of his creation. \z
					You should return to Spectulus in Edron to tell him the news.

You gave the plans to the astronomer. \z
					He began reconstructing the invention as soon as he got ahold of them. \z
					It will take a while for him to work out the problem which caused the initial failure.

You returned to Speculus who finally worked out the failure of the initial construction. \z
					He recapitulated the plans and needs only one item before he can start building the magic device.

missions.name: Mission 2: The Collector
texts:
Spectulus asked you to enter the Lost Mines beneath Edron and recover a rare crystal. In exchange for \z
				it you will gain access to the lair of the Collector who guards a vital component of the device.

Luckily, you survived the horrors of the Lost Mines and recovered a rare crystal. \z
				You should visit Spectulus in Edron to seek counsel on what to do next.
You returned to astronomer Spectulus and gave him the rare crystal.

missions.name: Mission 3: The Mirror Crystal
texts:
In order to access the lair of the Collector, you will need to find the creature's well on \z
					an ice isle near Carlin. To donate the rare crystal overcome your greed and use it at the well's pedestal.

You offered the rare crystal to the creature and can now enter the Collector's lair. \z
					Its crystal chamber cannot be accessed by outsiders. You need to find a way to snatch the Mirror Crystal.

The Collector has been defeated. \z
					You packed the fragile Mirror Crystal into the device Spectulus gave you. \z
					All yo have to do now is to return to the astronomer and to present him your acquisition.

It may have been the excitement or simple nervousness but as soon as Spectulus removed the crystal, \z
					it somehow slipped. Unfinishable for all eternity, the device left yet another scholar in despair.
