texts:
As far as we can tell, the orcs maintain some sort of training facility \z
					in some hill in the north-east of their city. \z
					There you should find lots of their war wolves and hopefully also some of the orcish powder.
Bring the Strange Powder to the Explorer Society representative to complete your mission.
You have completed The Orc Powder.

missions.name: The Elven Poetry
texts: This mission is easy but nonetheless vital. Travel Hellgate beneath Ab'Dendriel and get the book.
Bring back an elven poetry book to the Explorer Society representative.
You have completed The Elven Poetry.

missions.name: The Memory Stone
texts: In the ruins of north-western Edron you should be able to find a memory stone.
Bring back a memory stone to the Explorer Society representative.
You have completed The Memory Stone.

missions.name: The Rune Writings
texts:
Somewhere under the ape infested city of Banuta, one can find dungeons \z
					that were once inhabited by lizards. Look there for an atypical structure that \z
					would rather fit to Ankrahmun and its Ankrahmun Tombs. Copy the runes you will find on this structure.
Report back to the Explorer Society representative.
You have completed The Rune Writings.

missions.name: The Ectoplasm
texts: Take ectoplasm container and use it on a ghost that was recently slain.
Return back to the Explorer Society representative with the collected ectoplasm.

missions.name: The Spectral Dress
texts:
The queen of the banshees lives in the so called Ghostlands, south west of Carlin. \z
					Try to get a spectral dress from her.
Report to the Explorer Society with the spectral dress.

missions.name: The Spectral Stone
texts:
Please travel to our second base and ask them to mail us their latest research reports. \z
					Then return here and ask about new missions.
Tell our fellow explorer that the papers are in the mail already.

Take the spectral essence and use it on the strange carving in this building \z
					as well as on the corresponding tile in our second base.
Good! Now use the spectral essence on the strange carving in our second base.

missions.name: The Astral Portals
texts:
Both carvings are now charged and harmonised. You are able to travel in zero time from \z
					one base to the other, but you need to have an orichalcum pearl in your possession to use it as power source.

missions.name: The Island of Dragons
texts:
Travel to Okolnir and try to find a proof for the existence of dragon lords there in the old times. \z
					I think old Buddel might be able to bring you there.
Report back to Lurik with the dragon scale.

missions.name: The Ice Music
texts:
There is a cave on Hrodmir, north of the southernmost barbarian camp Krimhorn. \z
					In this cave, there are a waterfall and a lot of stalagmites. \z
					Take the resonance crystal and use it on the stalagmites in the cave to record the sound of the wind.
Report back to Lurik.
Now you may use the Astral Bridge from Liberty Bay to Svargrond.

missions.name: The Undersea Kingdom
texts: Captain Max will bring you to Calassa whenever you are ready. Please try to retrieve the missing logbook which must be in one of the sunken shipwrecks.
Report about your Calassa mission to Berenice in Liberty Bay.
Congratulations, you completed the remaining part of this mission!

missions.name: Treasure
texts:
Treasure is the favorite of the dragon lords. \z
			Find and take Kalyassa's treasures spread across the world.

missions.name: Knowledge
texts:
You learned that frost dragon's incitement is the thirst for knowledge, \z
			perhaps if you bring some to Gelidrazah's you'll meet him.

missions.name: Life
texts:
Undead dragons aspires for life. \z
			No better way to see life as it grows around the world, is there?

missions.name: Going Down
texts: Deliver 3 Gear Wheels to Xorlosh.

You sucessfully helped Xorlosh in repairing the elevator. \z
					You can now enter the teleporter to the eastern part of the mine.

missions.name: Justice for All
texts:
Nokmir told you that he is falsely accused of being a thief. \z
					You could help him by talking to Grombur about the case. \z
					Furthermore you should try to find that ring which belongs to Rerun.
You should talking to Grombur about Nokmir.
You should try to find that ring which belongs to Rerun everywhere in the mine.
You have found Rerun's ring. Bring the ring to the emperor Rehal and talk to him about Nokmir.
You informed emperor Rehal about your recent discoveries and he acquitted Nokmir of being a thief.
You told Nokmir about his acquittal and he granted you access to the northern mine.

missions.name: Pythius the Rotten
texts:
You won the battle against the malicious undead dragon Pythius the Rotten. \z
					He granted you firewalker boots as a reward.

missions.name: Sweet as Chocolate Cake
texts: Bake a Chocolate Cake and bring it to Bolfona at the bar.
Report back to Frafnar by telling him about the mission.

You told Frafnar that you did everything he asked you to do. \z
					You may now enter the western part of the mine.

missions.name: The Good Guard
texts:
Grombur asked you to get him a cask of dwarven brown ale. \z
					You heard that Boozer in Venore tried to brew some. Maybe you should pay him a visit.
Grombur liked the ale and you are now allowed to enter his part of the mine.

quests.name: The Hunt For the Sea Serpent

missions.name: Befriending the Musher
texts:
Find Sniffler the husky of Iskan. He should be somewhere north west of the town. \z
					He is probably marking his territory so you should be able to find his trace. \z
					Call him sniffler and feed him with meat.
Tell Iskan that you found and feed Sniffler

You are now a friend of Iskan and can ask him for a passage to Nibelor. \z
					You should ask Hjaern in Nibelor if you can help him.

missions.name: Nibelor 1: Breaking the Ice
texts:
Chakoyas may use the ice for a passage to the west and attack Svargrond. Use the rocks at east \z
					of nibelor on at least three of these places and the chakoyas probably won't be able to pass the ice.
You have broke 1 of 3 icepassages
You have broke 2 of 3 icepassages
You have broke 3 of 3 icepassages! Tell Hjaern your mission!
You should ask Silfind if you can help her in some matters.

missions.name: Nibelor 2: Ecological Terrorism
texts:
Siflind send you to travel to a distant land to get ants from an Ant-Hill to \z
					perform ecological terrorism on some pirates on Tyrsung. Just use the jug on an anthill.

Now head back to Svargrond and go to Buddel, the drunk sailor in southern Svargrond, \z
					and ask him to take you to Tyrsung. Now go all the way to the southern shores \z
					where you find a outpost. Go to the bottom deck and use the jug with the western mast
Go tell Siflind that you released the ants and aks her for mission!

missions.name: Nibelor 3: Artful Sabotage
texts:
Siflind gave you a Vial of Paint to use on some Baby Seals. \z
					Go back to Tyrsung and follow the shore from Buddel south. Use the Vial of Paint on three of these seals.
Go tell Siflind that you painted the seals and aks her for mission!

missions.name: Nibelor 4: Berserk Brewery
texts: The first things needed are 5 bat wings to brew a berserker elixir. Bring her them!
The next items Siflind need are 4 bear paws. Bring her them!
The next items Siflind need are 3 bonelord eyes. Bring her them!
The next items Siflind need are 2 fish fins. Bring her them!
The next item Siflind need is a green dragon scale. Bring her that!
You helped Siflind to defend Svargrond. Now Nilsor need help, go ask him for mission.

missions.name: Nibelor 5: Cure the Dogs
texts:
To cure Nilsor dogs, bring him the 1st of 7 ingredients: a Part of the Sun Adorer Cactus. \z
					Only an ordinary kitchen knife will be precise enough to produce the ingredient weneed.

To cure Nilsor dogs, bring him the 2nd of 7 ingredients: Geyser Water in a Waterskin. \z
					Use it on a geyser that is NOT active. The water of active geysers is far too hot.

To cure Nilsor dogs, bring him the 3rd of 7 ingredients: Fine Sulphur. \z
					Use an ordinary kitchen spoon on an inactive lava hole.

To cure Nilsor dogs, bring him the 4th of 7 ingredients: the Frostbite Herb. \z
					You can find it on mountain peaks. You will need to cut it with a fine kitchen knife.

To cure Nilsor dogs, bring him the 5th of 7 ingredients: Purple Kiss Blossom. \z
					The purple kiss is a plant that grows in a place called jungle. \z
					You will have to use a kitchen knife to harvest its blossom.

To cure Nilsor dogs, bring him the 6th of 7 ingredients: the Hydra Tongue. \z
					The hydra tongue is a common pest plant in warmer regions. You might find one in a shop.

To cure Nilsor dogs, bring him the 7th of 7 ingredients: Spores of a Giant Glimmercap Mushroom. \z
					The giant glimmercap mushroom exists in caves and other preferably warm and humid places. \z
					Use an ordinary kitchen spoon on a mushroom to collectits spores.

You found all ingredients to cure Nilsor dogs, ask him for mission. \z
				You can now travel by Dog Sleds to Inukaya.

missions.name: The Secret of Helheim
texts: Hjaern might have a mission for you. So maybe you go and talk to him.
Hjaern send you to find someone in Svargrond who can give you a passage to Helheim and seek the reason for the unrest there.
You discovered the necromantic altar and should report Hjaern about it.

missions.name: The Contact
texts: Get out of Nibelor and go to the Svargrond Explorer's Society. Ask Lurik for the mission.

Get to the raider camp, then follow to the extreme south where you find lots of barbarians. \z
				Near the southern most coastline, try looking for the NPC Nor. Ask him about Memory Crystal.
Go back to Lurik and deliver him the memory crystal.

Give Lurik some time to evaluate the information (ca. 5min). \z
				Then talk to him again about your mission.

missions.name: Formorgar Mines 1: The Mission
texts:
Find the entrance of the Formorgar Mines. \z
				Find some hint or someone who is willing to talk about what is going on there.

You found a old and tattered written paper in a skeleton next to a Restless Soul, \z
				you can only make out a signature: Tylaf, apprentice of Hjaern. Ask Hjaern about Tylaf.

missions.name: Formorgar Mines 2: Ghostwhisperer
texts: Go back to the mine and ask the restless soul about his story.
You already have listen to his story!

missions.name: Formorgar Mines 3: The Secret
texts:
The Cultists plan is to create a new demon army for their master to conquer the world. \z
				Hjaern and the other shamans must learn about it! Hurry before its too late.

The Cultists plan is to create a new demon army for their master to conquer the world. \z
				Hjaern and the other shamans are already informed!

missions.name: Formorgar Mines 4: Retaliation
texts:
Hjaern gave you a spirit charm of cold. Travel to the mines and find four \z
				special obelisks to mark them with the charm.
1 of 4 obelisks are marked.
2 of 4 obelisks are marked.
3 of 4 obelisks are marked.
Once all 4 obelisks are marked report back to Hjaern.
You got the Norseman outfit and you have access to the Yakchal room deep in the Formorgar Mines.

missions.name: Barbarian Test 1: Barbarian Booze
texts: You participate in the drinking challenge. Now you can get the permission for a few sips of barbarian mead in exchange for some honey.
Now drink from the bucket until you drink 10 sips in a row without passing out
You have mastered the first task of the barbarian test. If you haven't done so yet, talk to Sven about it.

missions.name: Barbarian Test 2: The Bear Hugging
texts: Somewhere north of Svargrond you will find a lonely bear which you have to hug. You wonder what you were thinking when accepting this quest...
You passed the bear hugging test (and should take a bath). If you haven't done so yet, talk to Sven about it.

missions.name: Barbarian Test 3: The Mammoth Pushing
texts: Find a mammoth north-west of Svargrond and knock it over. You wonder whether your mission is becoming a barbarian or rather commiting suicide.
You have knocked over a mammoth - though you wonder what this crushing noise at your spine was. If you haven't done so yet, talk to Sven about the mammoth pushing.

missions.name: The Honorary Barbarian
texts: You are now a honorary barbarian and can become a citizen of Svargrond. If you haven't done so yet, you should look for a barbarian in need of help in the north of the town.

missions.name: Mission 1: Interrogation
texts:
Your mission is to investigate the 5 guards in Thais regarding the Heretic behavior. \z
				Tim, Kulag, Grof, Miles and Walter are their names. If you do well you see a holy sprite on you.
You investigated 1 of 5 guards in Thais.
You investigated 2 of 5 guards in Thais.
You investigated 3 of 5 guards in Thais.
You investigated 4 of 5 guards in Thais.
You investigated 5 of 5 guards in Thais. Get back to Thais and report your mission to Henricus.
You investigated all guards in Thais.

missions.name: Mission 2: Eclipse
texts:
Henricus tells you to get The Witches' Grimoire, he sends you to Femor Hills where you \z
				can fly to the witches' mountain, say Eclipse to Uzon and he will take you there. \z
				Use the vial of holy water that he gives you on the big cauldron and open the chest to your left, \z
				then bring the witches' grimoire to Henricus.
Find the witches' grimoire and bring it to Henricus.
You already brought the witches' grimoire to Henricus.

missions.name: Mission 3: Vampire Hunt
texts:
Henricus wants you to find the Dwarfish Vampire Hunter, Storkus, located west of the Dwarf Bridge. \z
				It's good idea bring your 20 Vampire Dusts with you to save some time.
Go Back to Storkus the Dwarf and ask for Mission.

Now Storkus wants you to kill a vampire lord, The Count in the Green Claw Swamp, \z
				The Count is located near to the Blood Herb Quest. To summon The Count, \z
				you must use the coffin in the center of the room. Kill it and bring The Ring of the Count to Storkus.
Kill The Count and bring his ring to Storkus the Dwarf and ask for Mission.
Return to Henricus and tell him that you finished your job here.
Get back to Thais and report your mission to Henricus.

missions.name: Mission 4: The Haunted Ruin
texts:
Henricus will gave you a Special Flask (vial of holy water). Go to Liberty Bay \z
				and use the vial on an old house. Use this vial of holy water on that spot to drive out the evil being.
Kill the Pirate Ghost and get back to Thais and report your mission to Henricus.
You already cleaned the abandoned and haunted house in Liberty, ask Henricus for mission.

missions.name: Mission 5: Essential Gathering
texts: Henricus wants 20 Demonic Essences as a proof of your accomplishments.
Now ask Henricus for outfit to get the Demon Hunter Outfit.
You got the Demon Hunter Outfit! Ask Henricus for mission to unlock more addons.

missions.name: Mission 6: The Demon Ungreez
texts: Henricus wants you to kill a demon called Ungreez. Head to Edron Hero Cave and go down a few levels.
You killed Ungreez, report your mission to Henricus.
You got the the first addon of Demon Hunter Outfit! Ask Henricus for mission to unlock more addons.

missions.name: Mission 7: The Shadow Nexus
texts:
Your mission is to go to the Demon Forge and slay seven of The Ruthless Seven Minions. \z
				The Demon Forge is located in the Edron Hero Cave, through a portal after the Vampire Shield Quest.
You destroyed the shadow nexus! Get back to Thais and report your mission to Henricus.
Now ask to Henricus for a outfit. He will give you the 2nd addon of the Demon Hunter Outfits.
You got the the second addon of Demon Hunter Outfit! Go now to the reward room and choose one wisely!
You have completed The Inquisition Quest! You can now buy the Blessing of the Inquisition!

missions.name: Mission 01: New Land
texts: Explore the new land and reach the bottom of the mountain.
You have found a passage from the mountains. You can report back to Ongulf.
You have reported the scouted route to Ongulf.

missions.name: Mission 02: From Kazordoon With Love
texts:
Find Melfar of the imperial mining guild close to a mine entrance west of Kazordoon. \z
				Ask him to send more miners and wood.

Prepare the three trees which Melfar marked on your map with the beaver bait. \z
				Once you've marked all three return to Melfar and tell him about your success.
Melfar has finally promised to send more miners and wood. Report this to Ongulf in Farmine.
You have reported that Melfar will send more miners and wood for Farmine.

missions.name: Mission 03: Strangers in the Night
texts:
Find the unknown stalkers somewhere in the mountains. They apparently climbed up \z
				somewhere during their escape. Try to negotiate a peaceful agreement if possible.

You have talked to the leader of the primitive humans and have assured their peacefulness. \z
				Report this to Ongulf back in the base.
You have negotiated a peacful agreement between the dwarfs and the local primitives.

missions.name: Mission 04: The Mine Is Mine
texts:
Free the mine of the monstrous threat. Use a lift to reach the mines and look for a leader \z
				of the stone creatures. Slay this creature and report back to Ongulf.
You have slain the monster that terrorised the mines.

missions.name: Mission 05: Getting Things Busy
texts: You have gained the necessary support for Farmine.

missions.name: Mission 5: Support of Kazordoon's Worm Tamer
texts: Talk to the worm tamer in Kazordoon.
Find an item that interests Humgolf to get another chance.

missions.name: Mission 5: Support of the Edron Academy
texts: Talk to the magician Wyrdin in the Edron Academy.
Find an item that interests Wyrdin to get another chance.

missions.name: Mission 5: Support of the Explorer Society
texts: Talk to the representative of the Explorer Society in Port Hope.
Find an item that interests Angus to get another chance.

missions.name: Mission 5: Support of the Inventor Telas
texts: Talk to the inventor Telas in Edron.
Find an item that interests Telas to get another chance.

missions.name: Mission 5: Support of the Thaian King
texts: Talk to King Tibianus in the Thaian Castle.
Find an item that interests King Tibianus to get another chance.

missions.name: Mission 5: Support of the Venorean Traders
texts: Talk to Leeland Slim, the representative of the Venorean Traders.
Find an item that interests Leeland Slim to get another chance.

missions.name: Mission 06: Days Of Doom
texts: Try to pacify the orcs of the steppe. It is probably necessary to find some leader of the orcish tribes.

You have talked to the minotaur leaders of the orcs. They agreed to spare Farmine if you \z
				prove your worth in their arena. You will have to survive against Mooh'Tah master for 2 minutes, so prepare!
You have survived the arena. Talk to Curos again about your mission.
Your negotiations had moderate success. Your can report back to Ongulf.
You have ensured a brittle peace between Farmine and the orcs.

missions.name: Mission 07: Messengers Of Peace
texts: Find a lizardman somewhere in the north and try to start a negotiation of peace.

It seems that the lizardmen are not interested in peace and you will have to focus \z
				on other problems at hand.

missions.name: Mission 08: An Offer You Can't Refuse
texts:
Captured by lizardmen trap you have to find a way out of the prison. Perhaps \z
				something in your cell might lead you to an opportunity for freedom.
You managed to find a way of the captivity of the lizardmen - but for a price.

missions.name: Mission 09: Mortal Combat
texts:
You are expected to participate in the great tournament of the lizard race. \z
				Travel to the Isle of Strife and brave the challenges there.

You are the champion of the great tournament! Still the lizardmen are a menace to \z
				behold. You should report to Chrak before you leave the isle.

You have reported your latest doings to Chrak. It seems you bought the dwarfs some \z
				time of peace. Only the dragon kings may know how long though.

missions.name: Mission 10: New Horizons
texts:
Ongulf will be anxious to learn about your latest adventures. Travel back to Farmine \z
				for a final report.

Ongulf got very satisfied with your journey, this land is yours to be taken. You can \z
				find now on top of the mountain a red carpet, it might offer you access to some cities.

missions.name: Tome of Knowledge Counter
texts:
You brought the fist Tome of Knowledge to Cael. He learnt more about the lizard culture. \z
				Pompan will sell you dragon tapestries from now on.

You brought the second Tome of Knowledge to Cael. He learnt more about the minotaur culture. \z
				Pompan will sell you minotaur backpacks from now on.

You brought the third Tome of Knowledge to Cael. \z
				He learnt more about the last stand of the draken culture. Esrik will sell you lizard weapon rack from now on.

You brought the fourth Tome of Knowledge to Cael. \z
				He learnt something interesting about a certain food that the lizardmen apparently prepare. \z
				Swolt will trade you a bunch of ripe rice for 10 rice balls from now on.

You brought the fifth Tome of Knowledge to Cael. \z
				He learnt more about the last stand of the lizards in the South, Zzaion. \z
				Pompan will sell you lizard backpacks from now on.

You brought the sixth Tome of Knowledge to Cael. \z
				He learnt a few things about the primitive human culture on this continent. \z
				Cael will sell you War Drums and Didgeridoo from now on.

You brought the seventh Tome of Knowledge to Cael. \z
				He learnt something interesting about the Zao steppe. \z
				Now you to use the snake teleport at the peak of the mountain.

You brought the eighth Tome of Knowledge to Cael. \z
				He learnt a few things about an illness. \z
				Now you can enter a corruption hole in the north-eastern end of Zao.

You brought the ninth Tome of Knowledge to Cael. \z
				He learnt something interesting about the Draken origin. \z
				Esrik will buy lizard equipment from you now.

You brought the tenth Tome of Knowledge to Cael. \z
				He learnt more about the last stand of the lizard dynasty. \z
				Now you can enter the Zao Palace. It is situated deep underground, below the mountain base of the Lizards.

You brought the eleventh Tome of Knowledge to Cael. \z
				He learnt something interesting about dragons and their symbolism. \z
				You can buy a Dragon Statue from NPC Cael after you bring him a Red Lantern.

You brought the twelfth Tome of Knowledge to Cael. \z
				He learnt something about reveals some of the power structures in Zao. \z
				Cael will now make a Dragon Throne for you after you bring him a Red Piece of Cloth. \z
				He will reward you with 5000 experience points for each extra tome you give to him.

missions.name: Outlaw Treasure
texts: You made your way through the Outlaw Camp and found the hidden treasure of the bandits.

missions.name: The Hidden Seal
texts: You broke the first seal.

missions.name: The Plague Seal
texts: You broke the second seal.

missions.name: The Seal of Demonrage
texts: You broke the third seal.

missions.name: The Seal of Sacrifice
texts: You broke the fourth seal.

missions.name: The Seal of True Path
texts: You broke the fifth seal.

missions.name: The Seal of Logic
texts: You broke the sixth seal.

missions.name: The Kiss of the Banshee Queen
texts: The Banshee Queen kissed you. This meant your death, and part of your soul always belongs to her now. You broke the last seal.

missions.name: The Final Battle
texts: You have braved all dangers of the Banshee Quest and escaped the dungeon alive. The end room is sealed for you from now on.

missions.name: Mission 01: A Taste of Things to Come
Mission 02: Defence!
texts: Vascalir promised you some equipment, but first you need to build up some muscles. Find a big pile of stone in a barn to the north and use it to get a heavy stone.
You retrieved one stone from the big pile. Climb onto the roof of either Norma's bar, Obi's shop or the academy to find a catapult to use it on.
You loaded a stone on one of the catapults. One more to go! Climb onto the roof of either Norma's bar, Obi's shop or the academy to find a catapult to load with a heavy stone.
Two of the four catapults on the roofs are loaded. That should be enough to build up a decent defence. Return to Vascalir to turn in your quest.
You made sure that Rookgaard's defences are at their best. If the orcs try to enter the village, they won't have an easy time!

missions.name: Mission 04: Home-Brewed
texts: Vascalir doesn't have a job for you at the moment. He sent you to Lily in the south-west of town for another mission.
Lily gave you a bag with fresh herbs that need to be delivered to Hyacinth outside of the village. Leave the village to the north and walk east to find his little hut up a mountain.
You've delivered the fresh herbs to Hyacinth. He still has a reward for you though - make sure to talk to him again!
Hyacinth has another reward for you - make sure to talk to him again with enough space in your inventory.
You've delivered the herbs to Hyacinth and got potions and a ring as reward. Save the potions for when you're low on health and wear the ring if you want to regain health faster. Return to Vascalir.
You've told Vascalir about your successful delivery. The next mission awaits.

missions.name: Mission 05: Web of Terror
texts: Vascalir sent you to the spider queen's lair to retrieve a web sample. Leave the village to the north and cross the bridge to the north-west to find the lair. Look for greasy blue stones.
You've covered yourself in grease. It's a bit disgusting, but the spider queen will not be able to smell you for about two minutes. Enter her cave and USE an intact spider web to retrieve a sample.
You retrieved some of the spider queen's web. Return to Vascalir and try not to get caught by the queen on the way out!
The spider queen caught you in her net. If you had a sample of her web, you've lost it. Find a way out of her net and retry!
Vascalir took the sample from you. He still has a studded armor for you - talk to him once you have enough space in your inventory.
You've brought the spider queen's web back to Vascalir. This will definitely come in handy later on.

missions.name: Mission 06: Run Like a Wolf
texts: Vascalir sent you to Tom the Tanner, who can be found to the west of the academy. There you will get your next mission.
Leave the village to the north and walk north-east into the forest to find the wolves' den that Tom told you about. Hopefully you will find that poacher to take some leather from him!
You've entered the wolves' den - that was a one-way fall, but luckily you didn't get hurt. The poacher you were looking for is dead - but that doesn't mean you can't get some war wolf leather!
You've skinned a war wolf - but you alerted the wolf pack! Run to the exit, quickly!
RUN! You have only a limited time to reach the exit with the war wolf leather!
Phew - you managed to get out of the wolves' den in time. Return to Tom to finish your mission.
Tom gave you a pair of leather boots as reward for your good work. Vascalir surely has a new mission for you now.

missions.name: Mission 07: Attack!
texts: While you were gone, trolls have infiltrated the academy and set it on fire! Enter the burning vault deep underground and try to recover the copy of the book of orc language before it's destroyed.
You've done all you could - but unfortunately the book is lost. No need to lose heart though - there is still hidden knowledge about the orc language in the village, and the next mission awaits.

missions.name: Mission 08: Less Risk - More Fun
texts: Before getting revenge on the trolls, eliminate the risk of losing money on the way. Paulie has an interesting bonus offer for you if you deposit your money at the bank. Find him below the academy.
You've done as Vascalir asked and talked to Paulie. Remember to always leave your gold on your account! That way there's no risk of losing it.

missions.name: Mission 09: Rock 'n Troll
texts: Enter the troll lair to the north of the village and find the new tunnel which the trolls dug and used to infiltrate the Rookgaard academy. There, you need to find a way to destroy it.
Open the chests in the tunnel and use the pick on the 5 beams to weaken the structure and make the tunnel collapse.
You've weakened one of five beams.
You've weakened two of five beams.
You've weakened three of five beams.
You've weakened four of five beams.
You've weakened all the beams! Hurry out of the tunnel before it collapses!
The tunnel collapsed behind you. Time to return to Vascalir.
Vascalir rewarded you with experience, but there's still something he has to give you. You should talk to him again.
The trolls will not be able to enter the academy via their tunnel again. The village is safe for now - at least from trolls.

missions.name: Mission 10: Tomb Raiding
texts: Leave the village to the north and walk south-east to find the haunted graveyard. Descend into the crypt and find a sarcophagus that might still contain a fleshy bone. Bring it to Vascalir.
You've brought the fleshy bone back to Vascalir. Talk to him again to receive your reward.
You managed to get a fleshy bone from the crypt! Who knows what Vascalir plans with it - but this is going to be good.

missions.name: Mission 11: Sweet Poison
texts: Leave the village to the north and cross the bridge to the west, then walk south-west to find a wasp lair. Make sure you don't lose the flask Vascalir gave you.
You've found the wasp lair. Kill one wasp and use the empty flask on its dead body to retrieve some of its poison.
You've retrieved some lethal wasp poison. Bring it back to Vascalir to complete the mission.
You brought Vascalir the highly toxic poison. You should talk to him again to receive your reward.
You've retrieved highly toxic wasp poison for Vascalir. It's time for your final challenge.

missions.name: Mission 12: Into The Fortress
texts: This is it - the infiltration of the orc fortress and revenge on Kraknaknork awaits. Get the required items from a chest in the academy near the bank.
You've got all items you need to finally kill Kraknaknork. Don't lose them, and carefully make your way towards the orc fortress located in the far west of Rookgaard. Leave the village to the north.
You've knocked out the unsuspecting orc. USE the orc before it wakes up again to disguise yourself as an orc!
Even your mom wouldn't recognise you. You might not be able to fool all orcs in your disguise, but it should be enough to walk past the orc guarding the entrance.
You managed to sneak into the fortress. Use the fleshy bone and click on the elite orc guard with the crosshairs to create a distraction!
The guard is indeed very distracted - he smells delicious. At least to the wild dogs that entered the scene. This is the perfect time to enter the lower levels of the orc fortress.
You're inside the orc fortress! Now you need to find a kitchen and something that looks like a soup cauldron. Use the wasp poison on the cauldron to create an evil surprise for Kraknaknork.
You "spiced up" Kraknaknork's breakfast. Let's see how strong he still is after his meal. Proceed further into the fortress - and keep your tarantula trap ready.
You managed to slow down the furious orc berserker. Now, run through the teleporter while he isn't close to it!
You've entered Kraknaknork's room. Find a way to get rid of the energy barriers.
You solved the riddle of the energy barriers. The way to the throne room should be clear - for a short time. Be prepared for a massive fight!
You've entered Kraknaknork's throne room. Fight him! You can back out at any time via the teleporter, but you'll have to start the battle over. Once he is dead, enter the teleporter near his throne.
You've vanquished Kraknaknork and found his treasure room. You can probably take a few things from there before you leave - he wouldn't care anymore.
With the last bit of Kraknaknork's energy, you were teleported out of the fortress. Time to return to Vascalir victoriously.
You've vanquished Kraknaknork and brought peace to the village of Rookgaard. It will soon be time for you to leave for the Isle of Destiny, choose a vocation and enter the open world of Tibia.

missions.name: High and Dry
texts: Dedoras asked for you to talk to Charles, he knows about a small island.
You got stucked on this island. You must discover how to leave.
You successfully built a raft and used the starts to navigate your way through the waves. At least you found something of interest on the deserted island.
Congratulations you completed this mission.

missions.name: Liquid Death
texts: Dedoras has sent you to Spectulus in the Edron Academy. Rumors of strange fishmen in the Tiquanda region may be connected to some of the research the scholar conducted.
Spectulus asked you to check out the rumors of strange fishmen in the jungles of northern Tiquanda. A small sunken temple is said to be overrun by strange fish-like creatures.
You found a sunken temple deep in the Tiquanda jungle. Spectulus will help you enter the vortex at the entrance. Find out what happened there and take care of the fish-like aggressors...
Part IV
Part V
Part VI
Brokul has been defeated and now you can talk with Spectulus or Dedoras what you found about the fishmen.
Congratulations you completed this mission.

missions.name: Asuri - The Lament
texts: Go to Asuri Palace in Port Hope.
You were able to assemble an instrument with the objects found. That should work for something.
You must talk with the dead girl's mother, Gail, at Port Hope.

With a heavy heart you used a piece of ebony as well as the skull and hair of an unfortunate maiden to create a bone fiddle. By playing the Peacock Ballad you should be able to open the viollet portal.
You may enter the viollet portal. Check if there is something useful there.
In a secret room of the Asura Palace you discovered an old writing desk that contains an ancient map. This must be a hint to the secret library you are searching for.
Congratulations you completed this mission.

missions.name: The Order of the Falcon
texts: It is said that an ancient order of knights once resided in Edron. The knights disappeared a long time ago but their abandoned outpost is still there. The place may yet hold some surprises.
You defeated Grand Master Oberon in mortal combat. The Falcon Order may have lost its glory a long time ago but you are just getting started.
Congratulations you completed this mission.

missions.name: The Path of Defiances
texts: Go to Darashia and find out about the mysterious statue.
After you have been swallowed by a sand vortex you have entered a hidden desert area. A voice of unknown origin has informed you that you will have to face some challenges.
Part III
Part IV
Part V
Part VI
Part VII
You have found a book page in a chest. It seems to contain very useful information, but you are not capable to read it. At this point you have to speak with an expert.
Congratulations you completed this mission.

missions.name: Bursting at the Seams
texts: Dedoras told you where to search for leads to the Veiled Hoard: the museum in Thais, a fishmen temple in Tiquanda, an order fortress in Edron, the Asuri Palace and a deserted isle.
You talked with Gareth and now you may pass trougth the door.
Part III
Part IV
Part V
You successfully entered the Veiled Hoard of Zathroth. However, countless secret and vast knowledge still lie ahead.
You have reported Gareth about the enigmatic inscription you have found in the chamber of doom. He was able to decipher it for you and referred to Dedoras in Cormaya for further assistance.
Congratulations you completed this mission.

missions.name: A Djinn in Love
texts: You need to return to Marina and ask her for a date with Ocelus.
You need to return to Ocelus with the bad news.

Ocelus told you to get a poem for him, if you didn't buy one already, \z
				head to Ab'Dendriel and buy a Love Poem from Elvith.

You need to go recite the poem to Marina and impress her \z
				with the Djinn's romantic and poetic abilities.
After reciting the poem to Marina, she decided to date Ocelus and release Ray Striker from her spell.

missions.name: A Poem for the Mermaid
texts:
You need to find the man-stealing mermaid and try to break her spell over poor Raymond, \z
				the mermaid Marina is near the northern coast of the island.

You discovered that she does in fact have a spell on him, and will not release him unless \z
				someone better comes along.

You are a true master in reciting love poems now. \z
				No mermaid will be able to resist if you ask for a date!

missions.name: Access to Goroma
texts:
After helping Jack Fate to collect the 30 woodpieces, \z
				Jack Fate in Liberty Bay will bring you to Goroma.

missions.name: Access to Laguna Island
texts:
After arranging a date for Marina and Ocelus, you are allowed to use Marina's sea turtles. \z
				They will bring you to the idyllic Laguna Islands.

missions.name: Access to Meriana
texts:
After earning the trust of the governor's daughter Eleonore, \z
				Captain Waverider in Liberty Bay will bring you to Meriana if you tell him the secret codeword 'peg leg'.

missions.name: Access to Nargor
texts:
After convincing the people in Sabrehaven that you are a trustworthy hero, \z
			Sebastian will sail you to Nargor.

missions.name: Ray's Mission 1: Fafnar's Fire
texts:
Ray Striker asked you to travel to Edron and pretend to the alchemist Sandra that you are the one \z
				whom the other pirates sent to get the fire. When she asks for a payment, tell her \z
				'Your continued existence is payment enough'.
Sandra will be enraged and will cut any deals with pirates. Report back to Raymond Striker.

Ray Striker was pleased to hear about Sandra's rage. If you haven't done so yet, \z
				ask him for other missions.

missions.name: Ray's Mission 2: Sabotage
texts:
Buy a fire bug at Liberty Bay and infiltrate Nargor. \z
				Find the pirates' harbor and use the fire bug to sabotage their catapult there.

You were able to sabotage the catapult in the pirate's harbor. \z
				Report back to Ray Striker to tell him about mission.

Ray Striker was pleased to hear about successful sabotage. \z
				If you haven't done so yet, ask him for other missions.

missions.name: Ray's Mission 3: Spy Mission
texts:
Travel to Nargor and try to enter de pirate's tavern by deceiving the guard in front of it. \z
				Read all the plans which you can find in the tavern and report back to Striker.

You studied all of the pirate's plans in their tavern which will give insight about their next strikes. \z
				If you haven't done so yet, ask Ray for another mission.

missions.name: Ray's Mission 4: Proof of Death
texts:
Travel to Nargor and try to find out more about the mission Klaus offers. \z
				He apparently wants the death of Ray Striker and your task is to convince him that Ray is dead.

Klaus told you to kill Ray Striker and bring him his lucky pillow as a proof. \z
				Ray should be interested in hearing about this mission.

You informed Ray that Klaus needs his lucky pillow as proof of his death. \z
				Ray gave it to you, now go convince Klaus that the mission is fulfilled and Ray is Dead!

Klaus belieaves that Ray Striker is dead and will celebrate a big party. \z
				You should tell Ray about your successful mission.

Ray was very impressed to hear about your successful mission \z
				and gave you a ship and a pirate outfit as reward.

missions.name: Reputation in Sabrehaven: Suspicious
texts:
Ariella asked you for a few days of adequate supply. \z
				Help her and improve your reputation in Sabrehaven.

You have finished one mission. Ask around in Sabrehaven and surroundings whether the \z
				people there might have missions for you. This will improve your reputation and earn their trust.

Morgan asked you to deliver a letter safely to old Eremo on Cormaya. \z
				Help him and improve your reputation in Sabrehaven.

You delivered the letter safely to old Eremo. Report back to Morgan and \z
				improve your reputation in Sabrehaven.

You have finished two missions. Ask around in Sabrehaven and surroundings \z
				whether the people there might have missions for you. This will improve your reputation and earn their trust.
Duncan requested an atlas of the explorers society. Help him and improve your reputation in Sabrehaven.

You have finished three missions. Ask around in Sabrehaven and surroundings whether the \z
				people there might have missions for you. This will improve your reputation and earn their trust.

Chondur asked at least five pirate voodoo dolls to lift the curse. Help him and improve \z
				your reputation in Sabrehaven.

You have finished four missions. Ask around in Sabrehaven and surroundings whether the \z
				people there might have missions for you. This will improve your reputation and earn their trust.

Ariella asked you to bring a sample of whisper beer from a secret whisper bar in Carlin. \z
				Help her and improve your reputation in Sabrehaven.
Take the sample of whisper beer to Ariella. Help her and improve your reputation in Sabrehaven.

missions.name: Reputation in Sabrehaven: Friendly
texts:
You have finished five missions. People in Sabrehaven seem to start trusting you. \z
				Maybe this is a good time for some more difficult missions.

You have finished six missions. People in Sabrehaven seem to start trusting you. \z
				Maybe this is a good time for some more difficult missions.

You have finished seven missions. People in Sabrehaven seem to start trusting you. \z
				Maybe this is a good time for some more difficult missions.

missions.name: Reputation in Sabrehaven: Cordial
texts:
You have finished eight missions. \z
			People in Sabrehaven seem to trust you, but there is still one last mission left.

missions.name: Reputation in Sabrehaven: Loyal
texts: You have finished nine missions. People in Sabrehaven are considering you as one of them.

You have finished all missions. \z
				People in Sabrehaven are considering you as one of them and you earned their full trust.

missions.name: The Counterspell
texts:
You have begun Chondur's ritual. Bring him a fresh dead chicken so that he can begin to \z
				create a counterspell which will allow you to pass the magical barrier on Goroma.

You have begun Chondur's ritual. Bring him a fresh dead rat so that he can continue \z
				creating a counterspell which will allow you to pass the magical barrier on Goroma.

You have begun Chondur's ritual. Bring him a fresh dead black sheep so that he can \z
				complete his counterspell which will allow you to pass the magical barrier on Goroma.

You may pass the energy barrier on Goroma. The counterspell Chondur created for you \z
				with his ritual will allow you to withstand the evil magic of the cultist.

missions.name: The Errand
texts:
You told Eleonore to run a small errand. Deliver the 200 gold pieces she \z
				gave to the herbalist Charlotta in the south-western part of Liberty Bay.
You delivered the gold to Charlotta. Return to Eleonore and tell her the secret password: peg leg

missions.name: The Governor's Daughter
texts:
You promised to find Eleonore's lost ring. She told you that a parrot stole it from her \z
				dressing table and flew to the nearby mountains. You might need a rake to retrieve the ring.
You found the ring. Return it to Eleonore.
You returned the ring to Eleonore.

missions.name: Mission 1: Ivory Poaching
texts: Dorian wants you to collect 10 elephant tusks and deliver them to him.
You delivered the ten tusks to Dorian.

missions.name: Mission 2: Burglary
texts: Dorian wants you to steal a vase from Sarina, the owner of Carlin's general store.
You have stolen the vase, report back to Dorian!
You have delivered the stolen vase to Dorian, ask him for a new mission!

missions.name: Mission 3: Invitation
texts: Your task is to somehow convince Oswald to hand you an invitation to the king's ball.
You have received the invitation to the King's ball, report back to Dorian!
You have delivered the invitation to Dorian, ask him for a new mission!

missions.name: Mission 4: Bridge Robbery
texts: Dorian wants you to find a forger in the outlaw camp, go talk to Snake eye.
Snake Eye told you to visit Ahmet in Ankrahmun.
Ahmet told you that he will only help a friend and asked you to kill at least one Nomad.
You have killed a Nomad, go back to Ahmet!
You have received the forged documents from Ahmet, next is to get a disguise from Percybald in Venore!
You have received the dwarf disguise from Percybald. Now go do the deal with Nurik.
You have traded the forged documents for the painting, report back to Dorian.
You have delivered the painting to Dorian, ask him for a new mission!

missions.name: Mission 5: Enforcing Debts
texts:
Your mission is to travel to Tiquanda. Fina a hidden smuggler cave to the north of Port Hope \z
				and try to retrieve the valuable goblet which Dorian is looking for. Once you got it, bring it to him.
You have delivered the golden goblet to Dorian, ask him for a new mission!

missions.name: Mission 6: Fishnapping
texts:
Dorian wants you to fishnap Theodore Loveless' fish, first you need to get the key to his room. \z
				Talk to Chantalle in Liberty Bay.
You have received the key for Theodore Loveless' room, time to fishnap his fish!
You have fishnapped Theodore Loveless' fish, deliver it to Dorian.
You have delivered the fish to Dorian, ask him for a new mission!

missions.name: Mission 7: Blackmail
texts:
Your current task is to find compromising information about one of the \z
				Venore city guards, no matter how. A good starting point might be in their barracks.
You have delivered the compromising letter to Dorian, ask him for a new mission!

missions.name: Mission 8: Message
texts: Dorian wants you to deliver a message to his competitors in the dark cathedral.
You have put up the message, report back to Dorian.

You have reported back that you have completed the mission, \z
				Dorian now allows you to trade with Black Bert.

missions.name: Troubled Animals
texts:
You met the talking white deer Alkestios. It turned out he is actually a fae - and needs help. Search \z
				out a poacher camp north of the Green Claw Swamps and keep the poachers from hunting white deers.

You found a book with legends in the poacher camp. You asked Ahmed to add a story about how it brings \z
				ill luck to kill a white deer, hopefully the poachers will desist from hunting Alkestios.

You returned to the poacher camp and placed the faked book noticeably on a table. You're quite sure the \z
				poachers will discover it soon and desist from hunting Alkestios.

Alkestios asked you for help on another issue. There seemms to be a problem with a wolf mother and her \z
				whelps. Find the snake Ikassis in the north-west of Edron and talk to her, she knows more.

The snake Ikassis asked you to find a female wolf in the south of Cormaya. The animal is in need of \z
				help, yet Ikassis didn't know any details.

You found the ghostly wolf and promised to search for her lost whelps. The wolf told you to start \z
				your search at Ulderek's Rock

At Ulderek's Rock you found a sleeping war wolf. It might actually be the now grown up whelp you were \z
				looking for. The skeleton nearby implies that the hunter didn't survive his misdeed.

You talked to Irmana in Venore and she gave you the fur of one of the wolf whelps you're searching for. \z
				You should talk to their mother's ghost.

As the ghostly wolf asked you, you placed the whelp fur in the mouth of a nearby stone, that is shaped \z
				like a big face.
You redeemed the ghostly wolf. You should return to Ikassis and tell her about it.

Ikassis was happy to hear that you redeemed the ghostly wolf. But she asked you to help someone else: \z
				one of her sisters. You can find her in the guise of swan at a river sourth-east of Ikassis.

You met a swan that in truth is a swan maiden, a kind of fae. These fae have magical cloaks that allow \z
				them to shape change between swan and girl. Find this maiden's cloak that was stolen by a troll.

The troll Grarkharok sold the cloak to Tereban and he lost it during a flight with magic carpet. The \z
				cloak's feathers are now scattered along the carpet's beeline between Edron and Darashia.

You found many swan feathers on Edron and in Darama desert. Now you should have enough for an entire \z
				cloak. You should talk to the swan maiden.

You found enough magical swan feathers. The swan maiden will now be able to restore her cloak. You \z
				should talk to Alkestios again.

Alkestios was very happy about your support. You earned the Fae's trust and may now enter their secret \z
				realm. Search for an elemental shrine of ice, fire, earth or energy to reach Feyrist.

missions.name: Nightmare Intruders
texts:
You killed 200 of the nightmare monsters that are invading Feyrist. Maelyrra was very happy but it seems \z
				she still has other problems. She may need your help once more.

Maelyrra asked you to retrieve an artefact for her: the moon mirror. It was stolen by the tainted fae \z
				who inhabit the caves underneath Feyrist. She also asked you to free some captured fairies.

You found the moon mirror and freed the captured fairies. Maelyrra was very happy but it seems she \z
				has another problem. Perhaps you should offer your assistance once more.

The barrier that protects Feyrist from the outside world is weakened. To strengthen it again you \z
				need to find the starlight vial and the sun catcher. Ask Aurita and Taegen for these items.

Gather sunlight, starlight and moon rays. You have to do this with the sun catcher on the beach, with \z
				the starlight vial high in the mountains and with the moon mirror on a glade in the forest.

You may now repair the barrier. Charge the five moon sculptures of Feyrist with moon rays, the five \z
				dreambird trees with starlight and the five sun mosics with sunlight.

You repaired tha magical barrier that protects Feyrist from the outside world. The fae's secret realm \z
				is safe again.

missions.name: An Unlikely Couple
texts:
Help Aurita and Taegen and find a spell to transform Aurita's fishtail into legs temporarily. A \z
				fairy in a small fae village in the southwest of Feyrist might know more.

You have succesfully created the magical music notes for the mermaid Aurita. Talk to the faun \z
				Taegen, he also needs your help.

The faun Taegen wants to spend some time with his lover, the mermaid Aurita. He wants to visit her \z
				home and thus must be able to breath under water. Therefore he needs the rare raven herb.

You found the rare raven herb and gave it to Taegen. Now he will create a sun catcher for you. \z
				You may also ask Aurita for the starlight vial now.

missions.name: Mission 1: Skulled
texts:
Your mission is to find the Holy Skull. It is in a cave in the northern orc settlement, \z
				which is located north-west on the Zao Steppe.
You found the Holy Skull. Retrieve it to Lazaran in the Zao Mountains.
You brought Lazaran the Holy Skull. Ask him for new mission!

missions.name: Mission 2: All Around the World
texts:
You received the Skull of a Caveman and need to explore the world, letting the skull see everything. \z
				You need to stand at the highest place of Edron.

You received the Skull of a Caveman and need to explore the world, letting the skull see everything. \z
				You need to stand at the highest place of Ab'dendriel.

You received the Skull of a Caveman and need to explore the world, letting the skull see everything. \z
				You need to stand at the highest place of Femor Hills.

You received the Skull of a Caveman and need to explore the world, letting the skull see everything. \z
				You need to stand at the highest place of Darashia

You received the Skull of a Caveman and need to explore the world, letting the skull see everything. \z
				You need to stand at the highest place of Ankrahmun

You received the Skull of a Caveman and need to explore the world, letting the skull see everything. \z
				You need to stand at the highest place of Port Hope

You received the Skull of a Caveman and need to explore the world, letting the skull see everything. \z
				You need to stand at the highest place of Liberty Bay

You received the Skull of a Caveman and need to explore the world, letting the skull see everything. \z
				You need to stand at the highest place of Yalahar

You received the Skull of a Caveman and need to explore the world, letting the skull see everything. \z
				You need to stand at the highest place of Svargrond

You received the Skull of a Caveman and need to explore the world, letting the skull see everything. \z
				You need to stand at the highest place of Thais

You received the Skull of a Caveman and need to explore the world, letting the skull see everything. \z
				You need to stand at the highest place of Carlin

You visited all the highest places with the skull. \z
				Turn the skull back to Lazaran and report him your mission!
You turned the skull already back to Lazaran. Ask him for new mission!

missions.name: Mission 3: Dance Dance Evolution
texts: Lazaran told you to go to Ulala, who is located above Lazaran.

Ulala told you to dance to please their god Krunus. \z
				On the south mountain in the camp you will find the Krunus altar, there are lots of leaves on the ground.
You solved the dance. Head back to Ulala and report your mission!

missions.name: Mission 4: Bits and Pieces
texts:
Now the god Krunus is pleased, another god called Pandor needs to be pleased. \z
				Ulala wants you to collect 5 Orc Teeth, 5 Minotaur leathers and 5 Lizard Leathers. Bring them to her.
You brought Ulala 5 Orc Teeth, 5 Minotaur leathers and 5 Lizard Leathers. Ask her for new mission!

missions.name: Mission 5: Ray of Light
texts:
The third god which needs to be pleased is called Fasuon. \z
				Find the great crystal on top of mountain of Fasuon and pray there for his support!
You already prayed at the great crystal. Report it to Ulala
You have reported back to Ulala that you have completed the mission.

missions.name: Mission 6: Firewater Burn
texts: Speak with Lazaran and tell the gods are pleased now.
Bring Lazaran a Pot of brown water for a party after the great hunt.
You brought Lazaran the beer and got a Serpent Crest as reward!

missions.name: What a foolish Quest - Tasks of a Fool
texts: Cut a flower at the Whiteflower Temple south of Thais. Then report to Bozo about your mission.
You have finished your first mission and should ask Bozo for the next mission.

missions.name: What a foolish Quest - That stinks!
texts:
It sometimes stinks to be a fool. \z
				Collect some noxious fumes from a recently slain slime with the special vial. \z
				Then report to Bozo about your mission.
You have finished your second mission and should ask Bozo for the next mission.

missions.name: What a foolish Quest - A Piece of Cake
texts: Get 12 pies from Mirabell in Edron. Then report to Bozo about your mission.
You have finished your third mission and should ask Bozo for the next mission.

missions.name: What a foolish Quest - Fool Spirits
texts: Get 18 vials of wine for Bozo. Then report to Bozo about your mission.
Exchange the crates in front of Xodet's house and return to Bozo with the swapped crate.
You have finished your fourth mission and should ask Bozo for the next mission.

missions.name: What a foolish Quest - Watch out for the foolish
texts:
Steal the magic watch from the Triangle Tower west of Jakundaf Desert. \z
				Then report to Bozo about your mission.
Use the magic watch to steal the beard of the sleeping dwarven emperor.

You have already finished five missions for that fool. \z
				You should definitely talk to Bozo about your jester outfit now!

missions.name: What a foolish Quest - The queen of farts
texts: Get Bozo 4 pieces of minotaur leather.
Get Bozo a piece of giant spider silk.
Ask Bozo about your mission, he might be finished with the whoopee cushion by now.
Place the whoopee cushion on the queen's throne in Carlin by using the cushion with the throne.
You have finished your sixth mission and should ask Bozo for the next mission.

missions.name: What a foolish Quest - For your mice only
texts: Get the toy mouse of Queen Eloise's cat and show it to Carina, the jeweler in Venore, to scare her.
You have finished your seventh mission and should ask Bozo for the next mission.

missions.name: What a foolish Quest - Smoking is a foolish thing
texts: Gather some easily inflammable sulphur using a spoon on an inactive lava hole.
You brought Bozo the sulphur. Now cut him some leaves of the jungle dweller bush with a kitchen knife.
You have gathered the ordered ingredients and should ask Bozo for the next mission.
Deliver the exploding cigar to Theodore Loveless in Liberty Bay.
You have finished your eighth mission and should ask Bozo for the next mission.

missions.name: What a foolish Quest - A fool's bargain
texts:
Bozo wants you to fill a vial with the blood of a stalker. \z
				Use the vial on a slain stalker immediately after his death. Then report to Bozo about your mission.

Bozo wants you to fill a vial with the ink of a quara constrictor. \z
				Use the vial on a slain constrictor immediately after its death. Then report to Bozo about your mission.
You have gathered the ordered ingredients and should ask Bozo for the next mission.
Order 2000 steel shields from Sam. Sign his contract with the magic ink.
You have finished your ninth mission and should ask Bozo for the next mission.

missions.name: What a foolish Quest - A sweet surprise
texts:
Deliver a cookie to Avar Tar, Simon, Ariella, Lorbas, King Markwin, \z
				Hjaern, Wyda, Hairycles, the orc king and EITHER Yaman OR Nah'Bob. Then report to Bozo about the mission.
You have finished your tenth mission and should ask Bozo for the next mission.

missions.name: What a foolish Quest - The final foolishness
texts: Gather 5 pieces of white cloth for Bozo. Then report about your mission.

Travel to Darama and climb the highest point of the Plague Spike to give these pieces of white \z
				cloth an old and worn look. Some ancient altar should suit your needs best - use the white cloth on it.

Use your mummy disguise to scare the caliph Kazzan in Darashia. \z
				DON'T use the disguise too early or you will fail the quest.
You have finished all of Bozo's missions and you are a complete fool now. Yay!

missions.name: What a foolish Quest - To become a complete fool
texts: Now that you have a basic outfit, you should talk to Bozo about your missions to gain further rewards.

missions.name: Mission 01: Catering the Lions Den
texts: You must bring Zalamon 3 nails and a piece of wood so that he can make a Marked Crate for you.

Go to the tunnel in eastern Muggy Plains and reach the other side. \z
				Try to hide in the dark and avoid being seen at all by using the crate. \z
				After that you need to find the rebel hideout and talk to their leader Chartan.
You passed the maintenance tunnel and successfully made contact with the resistance in their hideout north of the Great Gate.

missions.name: Mission 02: First Contact
texts:
Chartan needs you to reactivate the teleport to the Muggy Plains. \z
				Head downstairs and into the temple and craft material to repair the teleport. \z
				To do this you will need some tools to improvise.

As you give the coal into the pool the corrupted fluid begins to dissolve, leaving purified, \z
				refreshing water. The teleporter is reactivated. Report back to Chartan.
Report back to Zalamon for the next mission.

missions.name: Mission 03: The Keeper
texts:
Zalamon gives you a Flask of Plant Poison to destroy plants in the garden \z
				of the Emperor to lure out and kill The Keeper to get his tail. The garden is southeast of the rebel hideout.
You killed the Keeper and got his tail. Bring it to Zalamon.
You brought the tail of the Keeper to Zalamon and completed the mission. Ask for the next mission.

missions.name: Mission 04: Sacrament of the Snake
texts:
Zalamon now wants you to go to Deeper Banuta and get an Ancient Sceptre \z
				that will help in the fight against the emperor. \z
				On each floor under Deeper Banuta you collect a sceptre part from a Ghost of a Priest. \z
				On the 4th and final floor you need to assemble the sceptre..

After you've assembled the Snake Sceptre and fought your way back out, \z
				head back to Zalamon and give it to him.
You have delievered the recreated sceptre to the rebels.

missions.name: Mission 05: New in Town
texts: Enter the imperial city Razachai to the west and talk to your contact in the ministry there for further missions.
Now you only have to walk west until you find Zlak inside the big green building.
You went deep inside the city to find Zlak and completed the mission. Ask for the next mission.

missions.name: Mission 08: Uninvited Guests
texts: Use the old escape tunnel in the northern basement of the ministry to enter the imperial palace. Fight your way to the basement to meet your new rebel contact.
You have reached your rebel contact Zizzle in the imperial palace.

missions.name: Mission 09: The Sleeping Dragon
texts:
To enter the inner realms of the Emperor you need to free the mind of a dragon. \z
				An interdimensional potion will help you to enter this dream and unleash his consciousness.
You travelled through the Sleeping Dragon dreams and freed his mind.

missions.name: Mission 10: A Message of Freedom
texts:
After solving the riddle, and talking again to the Sleeping Dragon you got a Spiritual Charm. \z
				Report back to Zizzle.

You possess the key to enter the inner realms of the emperor. \z
				Start with the one in the north-west and work your way clockwise trough the room and kill those manifestation. \z
				Then use your sceptre on the remain to destroy the emperor's influence over the crystal.

You possess the key to enter the inner realms of the emperor. \z
				You destroyed 1 of 4 emperor's influences.

You possess the key to enter the inner realms of the emperor. \z
				You destroyed 2 of 4 emperor's influences.

You possess the key to enter the inner realms of the emperor. \z
				You destroyed 3 of 4 emperor's influences.

You possess the key to enter the inner realms of the emperor. \z
				You destroyed all emperor's influences.

missions.name: Mission 11: Payback Time
texts:
Your Mission is to kill Zalamon. Step into the teleporter to confront him. \z
				Finally use your sceptre on the death body.
Go back to Awareness Of The Emperor and report him your success!

missions.name: Mission 12: Just Rewards
texts: The Emperor has promised you wealth beyond measure. Go claim it in the ministry.
You completed this Quest!
